Visited Smaaash recently and had an amazing time! The place has a great mix of arcade games, bowling, VR experiences, and go-karting, making it perfect for a fun outing with friends. The energy and vibe inside are always lively, and there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

If you’re looking for a place to chill, compete with friends, and have a fun day out, Smaaash is definitely worth visiting. Looking forward to coming back again!

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Bandivadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great experience playing cricket at Smash! The setup and overall vibe were really fun and enjoyable. Everything was well managed and we had an amazing time with friends.

A special thanks to Sneha Lad for helping us throughout the experience. She was very polite, supportive and made sure everything went smoothly. Great service and definitely worth visiting!

featured_reviews.name: karan momaya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Celebrated my daughter’s birthday here and it was an absolute blast!

The venue offers a fantastic mix of arcade games, VR experiences, go-karting, dashing cars, trampolines and so much more.

While the kids had an extravagant time, we adults got a chance to relive our early college days making it just as fun for us!

The food was freshly prepared and absolutely delicious. From cheese corn croquettes to pizza, pasta, noodles and pav bhaji everything left us wanting more.

A big shoutout to the organizing team Hardeep and Rishab who ensured everything ran smoothly while keeping the kids’ safety a top priority. Everything we needed was just a clap away!

Also, special thanks to Arun for giving us the confidence that this was the perfect venue for the celebration.

All in all, we truly Smaaash(ed) it!

featured_reviews.name: Rahil Kotadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash is a great place if you’re looking for a solid gaming and entertainment experience. From bowling and cricket to go-karting, there’s a good mix of activities that can easily keep you engaged for 5–6 hours.

They also have 3–4 good VR experiences that are definitely worth trying. The arcade games are decent, but you can skip a few of them and spend that time (and money) on the bigger experiences instead.

The space is well laid out, and even when it gets busy, the crowd feels manageable. Another plus is that the food here is good, making it easy to take breaks between games without stepping out.

One tip — check for combo packages or offers before you start playing. They can help you save a fair bit compared to paying for individual games.

Overall, it’s a fun spot for a long outing with friends or family.

featured_reviews.name: Marlene Barnes
featured_reviews.review_text:
This amusement centre needs significant maintenance. Few bowling lanes were not functioning, which was disappointing. The go-karting track is far too small, making the experience underwhelming. Food is overpriced, and the service is extremely slow.
Safety concern: Please be cautious at the main entrance (near the gate). There is a long, deep gap near the entry gate that is easy to miss. It presents a serious tripping hazard and could potentially cause injury.

featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh Kamwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash Lower Parel — Still Brings Out My Inner Child
I’ve been visiting Smaaash Lower Parel for more than a decade, and it’s one of those rare places that has managed to grow with time without losing its core charm.
Back in the day, it was all about adult-oriented fun — late nights, high energy, friends, and honestly, partying like an animal. The go-karting, especially at night, has always been a personal favourite, along with the bowling arenas, cricket box, and a wide mix of adrenaline-packed games that made it a go-to hangout spot.

Fun fact: I’ve literally celebrated every phase of life here — I even had a breakup party at Smaaash in 2014, which somehow makes my bond with this place even stronger 😄.

What I really appreciate now is how Smaaash has evolved over time. Initially, the focus was clearly more on adults, but lately they’ve done a great job of introducing kid-friendly games without taking away the excitement that adults come for.
Last night felt like a full-circle moment. I visited with my 11-year-old nephew and 7-year-old niece, and they absolutely loved it. From the games to the overall vibe, they were completely engaged and having a blast. Seeing the same place work just as well for kids today as it once did for us adults was genuinely satisfying.
Smaaash still does what it’s always done best ,it brings out your inner child, no matter your age. And now, with the younger generation hooked, I’m pretty sure I’ll be coming here regularly again.
A place full of memories, that adapts with time and still delivers fun... Smaaash Lower Parel continues to hit the mark.

featured_reviews.review_text:
🏛️ Churchgate Station & Heritage Building – A Glimpse of Timeless Mumbai
Right at the third stop during our visit, we reached the iconic Churchgate Railway Station area, and it instantly felt like stepping into a different era. The British-era architecture, beautifully preserved and maintained, stands tall as a reminder of Mumbai’s rich colonial past.
The building, especially at night, looked absolutely stunning with warm, golden lighting highlighting its intricate design, domes, and structure. Every corner reflects attention to detail—from the stonework to the symmetry—making it a visual treat for anyone who appreciates heritage architecture.
What truly stands out is how well the place has been maintained in its original charm, yet seamlessly integrated into the hustle of modern Mumbai. Even amidst the city’s fast pace, this structure holds a calm, dignified presence.
The surroundings were lively yet not chaotic:
A steady movement of people
Vehicles passing by in rhythm
The building glowing as a silent witness to decades of history
It’s not just a railway station area—it’s a living landmark, representing the evolution of Mumbai from its colonial roots to today’s metropolitan identity.
Overall Experience:
A perfect blend of history, architecture, and urban life, especially mesmerizing at night.
⭐ Rating: 5/5
✔️ Beautifully preserved heritage
✔️ Excellent night lighting
✔️ Iconic Mumbai landmark
✔️ Great for quick stops and photography
If you’re exploring South Mumbai, Churchgate is not just a transit point—it’s an experience in itself.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Kurup
featured_reviews.review_text:
The heartbeat of South Mumbai! 🚉💙
Churchgate isn't just a station; it’s an absolute vibe. If you want to see the real 'Mumbai Spirit' in action, this is the place. It’s the final stop, so you actually have a chance of getting a seat before the madness begins! 🏃💨
The Good Stuff:
✅ Clean & Organized: Surprisingly well-maintained for such a busy hub.
✅ Seamless Metro Link: The new Metro Line 3 connection is a game-changer for getting around.
✅ Iconic Location: Walk out and you’re minutes away from Marine Drive for that post-work sunset, or hitting up the legendary food stalls nearby. 🍦🌊
✅ Accessibility: Escalators and elevators actually work!
Pro Tip: If you’re a tourist, stand near the tracks during the afternoon to watch the Dabbawalas do their legendary lunchbox sorting—it’s like a synchronized dance. 🍱
It can get chaotic during rush hour (standard Mumbai rules apply: keep moving or get moved!), but there’s no better gateway to the city.
10/10 would catch a fast train from here again. ✌️

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Karve
featured_reviews.review_text:
Churchgate Station is one of the best-maintained suburban railway stations in Mumbai and easily earns a 4 out of 5 rating. The station has multiple spacious platforms that are relatively well-organized, making boarding and deboarding smoother even during peak hours. Signage across platforms and exits is clear, which helps both daily commuters and occasional visitors navigate without much confusion.
Cleanliness is noticeably better compared to many other stations in the city, with regular maintenance and less littering on platforms. There are adequate ticketing counters as well as ATVM machines, which help reduce long queues, although rush hours can still be hectic.
The station also offers a variety of small shops, food stalls, and kiosks for quick snacks, beverages, and essentials. Facilities like seating areas, drinking water, and basic washrooms are available, though washroom hygiene can still be improved.
Multiple exits make it convenient to access different parts of South Mumbai, and the connectivity to taxis, buses, and nearby offices is excellent. Overall, Churchgate Station provides a smooth, efficient, and fairly comfortable travel experience despite heavy daily footfall.

featured_reviews.name: Vijender Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Churchgate Station : Clean, Busy and Very Convenient

Churchgate Station is well maintained and one of the most organised stations in Mumbai. It’s very close to Marine Drive - just a short walk away which makes it easy for tourists and office-goers. Trains run smoothly every 2–3 minutes to different parts of the city so you never have to wait too long.

The platforms are clean, the signboards are clear and there’s good crowd management during peak hours. Outside the station, you’ll find plenty of taxis, buses and food stalls. It’s also a major starting point for exploring South Mumbai including Nariman Point, Colaba and Fort area.

A reliable and convenient station whether you're commuting daily or visiting the area.

featured_reviews.name: Anil Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: Churchgate Station is the bustling, iconic southern terminal of Mumbai's Western Line, offering easy access to Nariman Point, Marine Drive, and tourist spots. As a heritage site, it has a charming, old-world exterior but is intensely crowded with daily commuters, making it a high-energy, "mad rush" experience during peak hours.

featured_reviews.name: Ansuman Bag
featured_reviews.review_text: Churchgate Station is an iconic and historic landmark that serves as the ultimate gateway to South Mumbai. As a major terminus, it handles an incredible volume of daily commuters with surprising efficiency. The station premises are well-maintained, remarkably clean, and feature clear signage that makes navigating the heavy peak-hour rush manageable. Food stalls, ticketing counters, and basic amenities are easily accessible. Its location is unbeatable—stepping right outside connects you directly to top colleges, corporate hubs, and it’s just a scenic stroll away from Marine Drive.

featured_reviews.name: Parva Dave
featured_reviews.review_text: Churchgate Station is one of the best railway stations in Mumbai. It is clean, well-maintained, and well-connected to different parts of the city. The station has clear signboards, good security, and plenty of facilities for commuters. Trains are frequent, making travel convenient and efficient. The surrounding area is lively, with easy access to colleges, offices, and tourist attractions. Overall, a great station that provides a smooth and comfortable travel experience. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
The Heart of Mumbai's Cricket and Heritage!

"Oval Maidan is a vast and vital green space in the Fort area, providing a much-needed open area in the busy South Mumbai.

It is most famous for its role in Mumbai's cricket scene, with countless matches being played simultaneously, especially on weekends.

Occupying a majestic 22-acre expanse in the heart of South Mumbai,the Oval Maidan is a sublime palimpsest of colonial grandeur and contemporary leisure. Enveloped by the architectural duality of the Victorian Gothic revival to the east and the sleek Art Deco ensembles to the west now collectively enshrined as a UNESCO World Heritage site the ground serves as a verdant bridge between centuries.
To traverse its periphery is to witness a sophisticated choreography of Mumbai’s social fabric. Under the watchful shadow of the Rajabai Clock Tower, the air is thick with the rhythmic thwack of willow against leather, as aspiring cricketers populate the dusty pitches in a relentless pursuit of sporting excellence. The maidan functions as a civic lung, exhaling a serene tranquility that contrasts sharply with the frantic kinesis of nearby Churchgate.
The aesthetic appeal lies in its unmanicured authenticity; it is neither a rigid botanical garden nor a chaotic wasteland, but a curated void that permits the city to breathe. As the golden hour bathes the limestone gargoyles of the High Court in amber hues, the Maidan transcends its physical boundaries, becoming a temporal sanctuary. It is an indispensable urban theater where history remains a living, breathing participant in the everyday life of the metropolis. For the discerning visitor, it offers a peerless vantage point to observe the architectural and cultural heartbeat of Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Govind Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Brabourne Stadium is a truly iconic and historic venue, and watching a live match or attending an event here is a memorable experience at least once in a lifetime. Located near Marine Drive and just a short walk from Churchgate station, the stadium is very easy to access by train, though parking can be a challenge if you’re coming by car.
The entry process is smooth and well managed, with good security arrangements and police presence ensuring safety. Assigned gates help maintain order, and overall crowd handling is systematic. The seating capacity is huge, wide, and spacious—though the plastic chairs could definitely be more comfortable. Some seats are even tied with ropes, which adds a bit of humor to the experience 😄.
The atmosphere during big events like IPL or WPL is absolutely electric. The energy of the crowd, loud cheers, stadium lights, and nail-biting moments make the experience unforgettable. Even if your favorite team isn’t playing, the vibe pulls you in completely. Being part of a packed stadium during such high-profile matches feels surreal and special.
Food and beverage options are available inside, though prices are on the higher side—sometimes jokingly feeling like “train-style vendors charging flight rates” 🫣😂. That said, free drinking water is provided, which is a big plus. Washrooms are decent and well maintained. Network connectivity, especially mobile data, can be weak inside the stadium, so it’s best to be prepared for that.
The stadium complex itself is very well maintained. Facilities like clean washrooms, clear signage, gardens, and even the swimming pool area (for CCI-organised events) are maintained to high standards. Staff are helpful, cooperative, and professional, contributing to a smooth overall experience.
A few things to keep in mind: bags, coins, water bottles, and high-end cameras are not allowed inside, and items may need to be left at the gate at your own risk. East Block seating has no roof, so for afternoon matches, west-side tickets are recommended. Carry a cap or umbrella for daytime events.
Overall, Brabourne Stadium offers a fantastic blend of history, excitement, and live sports energy. Despite minor inconveniences like seating comfort and food pricing, the experience of watching a match here is thrilling and worth it. A must-visit venue for sports lovers and anyone looking to soak in Mumbai’s sporting spirit 🏏✨

The surrounding area is vibrant, with plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby, including options at Nariman Point and Colaba, perfect for a post-match meal.

What sets Brabourne apart is its old-world charm, blending cricketing history with modern amenities. Unlike some larger stadiums, it provides an intimate yet energetic match experience. If you’re in Mumbai during a cricket season, catching a game here is highly recommended!

Big Name, Huge Disappointment – Proceed with Extreme Caution!
Garware Club House has a massive reputation, but their actions are incredibly small. If you are planning the most important day of your life here, my personal advice is to look elsewhere unless you want to spend your entire wedding drowning in stress.
Here is a breakdown of the reality behind the "big name":
• The Cancellation Trap (The Biggest Drawback): Please read their terms and conditions carefully. They reserve the right to cancel your hall booking at any time—even just 4 days before the wedding! While our wedding was thankfully saved, several weddings near our date were abruptly canceled simply because of a match or event at Wankhede Stadium. You will constantly be on edge.
• Unreliable & Poor Accommodations: You would expect the bride and groom to have a guaranteed space to get ready, but management can cancel your room booking for the most ridiculous reasons. Even if you do get a room, they are not in good condition. The ACs do not work properly, and the staff brushes off complaints with "renovation" excuses. No one listens to your issues, and no one actually cares about your event.
• Decorator Monopoly & Broken Promises: There is a strict monopoly of just two decorators, and their prices are exorbitantly high. Worse, they do not deliver on their commitments. Our grand entry was not executed as promised, guest chairs were missing, and the decorator didn’t even bother setting up a table for our family dinner.
• Hidden Costs & Extortionate Demands: You have to pay explicitly for valet parking. Then, after your event is over, the staff will hound you for extra money, acting as if they provided excellent service. Expect them to brazenly demand anywhere from ₹10,000 to ₹25,000.
• The Only Saving Grace: Swad Catering. The catering team was genuinely good, and the food tasted awesome.
Final Verdict: Save yourself the mental agony. Do not book this hall if you want peace of mind regarding whether your venue will actually be there on your wedding day. If you do consider it, read every single line of the terms and conditions before signing anything!

The environment felt unsafe, unprofessional, and deeply disrespectful, especially for paying guests celebrating a private occasion. My birthday was completely ruined, and I will never recommend this place.

Public note:
Next time, boys and men — please wear sandos (ganjis) 😍
Apparently, this is the only club in Mumbai that proudly entertains men in innerwear 🤣🤣🤣🤣

Despite all this, there was not even a single apology. The PR (J*Y), who was never present to check on guest safety or comfort, suddenly appeared at billing time demanding cash.

PR J*Y and the owner present that night — after witnessing the abuse and repeated complaints, no one took a stand for the truth.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.

featured_reviews.name: Ajish Narayan
featured_reviews.review_text: We Hosted our company party at Game Palacio Kurla location and it was an absolute blast! The atmosphere was vibrant and the perfect mix of competition and socializing. featured_reviews.name: Harshvardhan kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: It was our first time for Bowling. There is no prior reservation required it is first come first serve basis. Since it was weekend we were charged 500+ taxes with buy one get one offer and this offer is from morning uptil 4 PM, 20 balls each player. It was a fun experience though and you can visit with ur friends here. On one bowling track four players can play together. There is screen above which tells u about score among players. There are other games too and for which u need to pay different charges. There is attached resto- bar where you can enjoy meal( it has its own menu and need to pay according to menu). Overall it was an amazing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Krishna Madhwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Game Palacio. The overall vibe of the place is great, but the service completely ruined it for us.

The staff (Sumit) was extremely rude and unprofessional. We were pressured to place our food order because the staff wanted to close the kitchen — even though it was still one hour before the official closing time. Instead of politely informing us about last order timings, the approach was pushy and disrespectful.

When customers visit a premium place, they expect basic courtesy and professionalism. Unfortunately, that was missing here. Management seriously needs to train their staff on customer handling and hospitality.

Very disappointed with the service experience. Would think twice before visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: LM Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: In case one wants to enjoy good music, food and bowling alley all at one place, this is the place. Great crowd. Alcohol, cocktails and mocktail are served. Waiting for your chance of bowling may take up to an hour during weekends.
